title: Rich vs Poor: Ghurbat Jaib Mein Ya Soch Mein?

seo_description: Babur Ayub on rich vs poor: poverty is not only in the pocket but in the thinking too, and why failure is a blessing for those who learn from it.
keywords: ghurbat jaib mein ya soch mein

guest.name: Babur Ayub
bio: Babur Ayub has 25+ years of leadership experience in Pakistan's retail and fashion industry, including Chenone, Hang Ten, Servis Group, Imperial Stores, Khas Stores and Onieo.

He is a lecturer at STEP IADM, a startup mentor, and the author of "Management by Qur'an". He appears in Find Your Clarity, the short-episode series by Muffled Minds in which each episode takes one big question everyone is confused about and looks for clarity.

summary: In Episode 3 of Find Your Clarity, host Khawar Shahzad talks with Babur Ayub about rich versus poor — and the answer is not about money alone. Babur argues that poverty is not only in the pocket, it is in the thinking and the feelings too: a person can be financially rich and emotionally, intellectually, spiritually or culturally poor, and the definition of rich has to be a package of all these areas, not money alone.

Babur explains why rich people think differently — they can afford to lose, so they think outside the box — and why the poor get poorer: the poor do not put all their energies and talent into work, while the same body, senses, oxygen and seasons are given to everyone. He illustrates it with his own life: born into a privileged family, he lost his father's money in the 1994 stock market crash, and rebuilt himself by selling custom-made shirts door to door in corporate offices, including the day he met a CEO who was sitting shirtless in his office.

The episode closes on failure and on being rich but poor inside: failure is a blessing if you learn from it — try, fail, try again, fail again, fail better — and real authority is not in arrogance but in kindness and in staying connected with people at every level, from sweepers and security guards to office boys.

takeaways: Poverty is not only in the pocket, it is in the thinking and in the feelings too — and a person can be financially rich but emotionally poor.
Rich is a package, a combination of multiple areas: financial, emotional, intellectual, spiritual and cultural — not money alone.
A rich man can afford to lose the profit for one month and still live; a poor man whose salary does not come for one month sees his whole budget, family system and mental health disturbed.
Failure is a blessing if you want to learn from it, and a curse if you don't: try, fail, try again, fail again, fail better.
Losing a match 10–0 and then losing 2–0 means you improved — the art of failing better is very important.
The emotionally strong person is not controlled by emotions, he controls them: he will not answer abuse with abuse.
Opportunities and success go to those who tolerate imperfections and appreciate people, not to those who find fault in everything.
Real authority is not in arrogance, it is in kindness and in making good contact with people at all social levels.

this is economic side of richness and being poor. To economically to ek angle hai jismein, no doubt, in few third world countries, you gain power when you gain finance. When you are financially strong, you actually are in a position to buy a lot many power sectors to control the audience, to control the country, like you see the politicians. years ke andar bhi aapne notice kiya hoga ke they people are known as the rich people, the males, but they have somehow gone into some criminal kind of activity, murder ho gaye un se, aur woh kya tha? Woh emotionally poor the. So I think this has to be a package, a combination of multiple areas, jis se hum define kar sakein ke yeh rich hai aur yeh poor hai. Is ki reflection khaali paison par nahi aani chahiye. So I believe ghurbat sirf jaib mein nahi, soch mein bhi hoti hai. Haan, soch mein bhi, jazbaat mein bhi,

jo aap ki intellectual richness bhi hai, intellectually poor bhi hai, spiritually rich bhi hai, spiritually poor bhi hai, to in sab ke apne apne impacts hain, implications hain, on society, on your individuality. So how do you judge a person, money-wise ya source-wise, ke woh source se rich hai? How do you judge? Agar main bilkul apni specific baat karoon, to main bhi isi muashre ka hissa hoon, aur main normally yeh dekhta hoon ke hum kin logon ko milna pasand karte hain. Hamara criteria milne ka kuchh bhi ho, lekin hamari choice kya hoti hai? Kis ko milna humne?

Jis se hamein kaam hai, koi jis ke saath hamara koi vested interest hai, jo hamare kaam mein hamari madad kar sakta hai, hamare connections ko expand karne mein hamari madad kar sakta hai, hamein kahin na kahin se financial benefit dilwa sakta hai, to unfortunately jo saare ka saara focus hai, woh shift ho ke aapke financial interests ke upar aa jata hai. Aapne aise bahut kam log dekhe honge jo is liye kisi ko milne ke liye ja rahe hain: bada qaabil aadmi hai, badi gehri soch hai, spiritually bada rich hai, is ke saath baithoon ga to badi cheezein learn karne ki opportunity milegi, aur main us ke saath do ghanta baith jaoon ga. Whereas in actuality, aap dekhein ke do ghanta baithne ke liye un ke paas time hi nahi hai. Everyone is so busy in making money, or in thinking about making money, ke woh intellectual

richness ke upar kaam nahi kar raha, ya us mein interest nahi le raha, woh emotional richness mein kuchh learn karne ki koshish nahi kar raha, culturally rich nahi hai. To gaadi to aa gayi, achhi se achhi aa gayi, libaas bhi achhi se achhi aa gayi, libaas bhi achhe se achha brand, aapne outfit, branded outfit pehen liya, joota bhi achha khareed liya, bag bhi achha carry kar liya, lekin ab aap culturally us ko us ke saath align kaise karenge ke aap waqai ameer hain? Ameer in a sense that it should not be labeled as the person who should get some kind of privilege. This should not be a privilege, paise zyada hone se us ko privilege mil rahi hai in some societies, whereas in other societies, aap bhi jaante hain, wahaan paiso se superiority nahi mil rahi, paiso se privilege nahi mil rahi, woh us ke knowledge se, us ke skill se, us ki manner se, us ki intellectual

capacity se us ko respect mil rahi hai, because that specific person, having all these other features, might be more beneficial for the society as a whole. To jabke hamare mulk mein, the first thing we look at, or we want to see in other people, if they are rich, if they are influential, if they can spend money, so you try to be in touch with them. Yaar, in ka circle achha hoga. Abhi hum off the camera baat kar rahe the, circles ki. To ab, aap ke circle agar karna hai, to aap ke circle, finance is one of the pivotal things. The protagonist idea behind connection development is that that person has so much influence that can benefit me financially.

The circle is such that I can also fall in that circle with him, and enjoy with him, with all the perks and privileges and all that. Ya businessman ho to koi aisa theka mujhe mil jaye, kisi wazeer ke saath baith ke, to wazeer kya hai? Wazeer ke paas kis cheez ka influence hai? Prime Minister ke paas kis cheez ka influence hai? Us ke paas sab se pehle paisa tha, ke he can afford to be the head of the state, not because he is more intelligent, or because he is intellectually very strong, or he is very deep. The only criteria to choose a prime minister is one: that he can afford the expense of the election, or he can buy as many members as he wants to be the head of the state. So, roughly speaking, yeh ek zamane ki zaroorat bhi to hai. Lekin jo third world countries hain, jahaan pe

aap morally bankrupt ho gaye hain, jahaan pe aap jhoot bolte hain, ya jahaan pe aap hypocrites hain, to wahaan pe in cheezon ki value zyada hai. Jab aap emotionally honge, jab aap emotional crisis mein aayenge, aur emotionally poor ho jaenge, to phir aap ka kya hoga? Aap ke ghar ke jhagde badh jaenge, aap ki jo rifts create ho jaenge, relationships ke andar, to aap ke bahut saare problems aayenge, because there you are not controlling the emotions. If you are rich, you are controlling, but a poor is being controlled by the emotions.

So what do you think, what would be the percentage of these things? Like, ek judge karta hai financially, ek judge karta hai ke how wise the other person is. Mera khayal hai, aaj kal ke zamane mein to koi wisdom ko utni ahmiyat hi nahi hai. Everybody thinks that nobody is more wise than me. Claim sab logon ka hai, ek kisi ek aadmi ka nahi hai. Abhi main aur aap baithe hain, ho sakta hai hum donon apni apni jagah pe bade smart hon, and yeh claim, yeh claim jo sick societies hain, us mein hota hai zyada, jo emotionally aur culturally sick hain, jo spiritually sick hain, un societies ke andar yeh claim, artificial claim zyada honge ke yaar,

kya sayana hoga, yaar mere se zyada sayana kaun hai? To is ko leke, jo societies ki formation hai, ya jo social culture establish karne ki baat hai, ya jo law ko apply karne ki baat hai, wahaan jahaan pe aap ki hypocrisy nahi hogi, jahaan pe jhoot ka culture nahi hoga, wahaan pe aap ko kam adalaton ki zaroorat padegi, kam judge chahiye honge, kyunke aap ki bahut saari cheezein controlled by the authority you have already established. Jahaan pe aap ne control nahi karna, jhoot bolne wale zyada hain, munafiqat karne wale zyada hain, chori karne wale zyada hain, to aap ko zyada adalatein chahiye, zyada judges chahiye, zyada faisle chahiye. Aap apne mulk mein dekh lein, kehte hain ke itna pipeline mein case pada hua hai ke jo agle 20 saal khatm hi nahi hoga,

Supreme Court ka ya High Court ka aur all that, to what is that? Yeh saari us vacuum ko hum ne fill kar liya hai, jo create hua tha, and that was good, ke woh create hua. Us vacuum ko hum achhi cheez se fill kar sakte the, moral grounds pe improvise karke, spiritual grounds pe apne aap ko behtar karke, culturally apne aap ko zyada cleanliness ke saath present karke, lekin hum ne to saari cheezon mein artificiality ko preference di hai, to artificiality will, you know, bring in nothing, not good results. But on the other hand, why do the rich think differently?

Ek aadmi can afford to lose the profit for one month, and if he can still live, if he can still afford to live without that profit of one month, he is called rich, because us ki tension us ki monthly profit sharing mein nahi thi, us ke paas itna sufficient tha, itna abundant hai woh ke us ko us ki problem face nahi hoti. Aur ek poor aadmi kya hai, ke jis ko jis ki salary na mile ek maheena, to us ka saare ka saara budget, saare ka saara khaandaani nizaam, poori ki poori us ki mental health, us ki jo mindset.

Poore saare disturb ho jata hai, woh khatam ho jata hai, ke yaar main is ek maheene mein kya karoon ga? To aap ka kya question tha? Why do rich people think differently? They should think differently because they have more capacity to afford more losses, or they can be more kind and they can spend more. Out of the box, you can say. Out of the box, you can say. To zaroori rich hona zaroori nahi hai. But yeh nahi hai, jo rich nahi hai, woh apne us circle mein usi box ke andar hi sochta rahega, jo us ke financial... Rich in what sense? Woh rich hai paiso mein?

To paiso mein jo rich hai, woh aap bade bakheel aap bhi nahi dekhe is muashre mein, jinka paise bahut zyada hain lekin woh welfare par spend hi nahi karte hain. Woh phir ameer hai? Ameer phir woh hai ke jo wahaan par, us us point par aa ke, morally and emotionally bhi rich hai. Emotionally agar rich hoga, to he'll be more sensitive. Abhi ek paros mulk mein ek [unclear] hue hain, theek hai, un ko agar aap example lein, un ki life ki, bahut se log bayaan kar rahe hain, aur woh printed aur woh established fact hai ke un ka jo net worth tha, us mein se 90% he had already devoted to the poor farmers. Whereas he could have purchased lot more properties,

Lot more supercars, lot more other things. He improved his life in a sense, in cosmetics and optics, in a sense. But he was actually rich in terms of he was more willing to spend on other people, those who deserved. Once Shah Rukh Khan said, first become rich and then speak wisdom. Whatever you will speak, it will become wisdom. What do you think? Okay, ek American senator tha, and in 1973-74, when the crisis in Wall Street was a crisis, the market crashed.

He was the one person who became rich, and all the rich of that time became poor, financially. We also relate to that. Yes. So, what was it that they said? Once I have got something and I have now established my power, so whatever I will say, that will become the truth, and nobody can challenge my truth. I mean, it takes long. Jo financial power hai, woh aap ko saath laati hai, aapke other establishments bhi, other powers bhi, woh us ko endorse karti hain, woh aapke, yaani us ko challenge karne ke liye woh.

Rukh hi maujood nahi hai, woh insaan hi maujood nahi hai jo us ko challenge karein aur us ko challenge karke apne talaqaat bigaad lein, aur phir us ke baad usi bande se unhon ne roz uthna baithna ho, to they deliberately, I think, they live a pretentious life, ke yaar theek hai, agar keh raha hai to theek hoga. Aur actually mein bhi agar aap dekhein, reality hai, woh yeh hai ke har bande ki ek apne experience ki base par truth hoti hai, aur us truth ko usne explore nahi kiya hota hai, us truth ko usne jiya hota hai, usmein jiya hota hai, usmein us pain mein se woh guzra hota hai. Only then he become so authoritative.

And can say loud ke ji yeh nahi, yeh hai. Shah Rukh ki aap baat karein, to unhon ne shuru ki pehli do teen filmon ke baad, kisi ne un ki mulaqaat Amitabh sahab se karwayi, to unhon ne baat ki ke yeh hamare waqt ke superstar hain, aur aap in se mile hain, aur aap apne waqt ke superstar honge. But aap apne waqt ke superstar honge, to aap rich kidhar se hain? Aap mindset rich hain.

Aur agar aap mindset rich hain, to phir aap ko pata hai ke meri manzil kya hai, aur mujhe kitni mehnat karni hai udhar pahunchne ke liye, aur phir kya kya mujhe sacrifices karni padengi. Do whatever it takes, phir baat hai ke kya sacrifices. And finally, if you see yourself in your life, that you have achieved that level of success, that yardstick has been crossed, to aap, you are one of the luckiest person. Abhi, matlab, kuch reels chal rahi hain, jismein ek aap ka younger version hota hai, ek aap ka present hota hai, to us mein aap ka younger version aap se pooch raha hota hai ke 'How are you doing?' To woh kuchh keh raha hota hai ke 'I have achieved that thing.' To ab woh jo present hota hai, woh apne younger version ko kehta hai ke 'Don't give up.'

Just jo aap struggle aap kar rahe ho, woh karte raho, you will succeed one day. To yeh again, woh mindset wali baat. Dekhein, main aap ko ek mukhtasar si batata hoon ke main jis family mein paida hua, wahaan pe woh saari facilities maujood thi, jo ek family mein ek bachche ko jo privileges chahiye hoti hain, jo facilities, woh saari maujood thi, aur main bada confident tha, maybe I was more confident at that time. I had invested in stock exchange. I had invested in the money of my father. I started to gain.

Every day I was making money. So I felt like this was a non-stop process, that it would never stop. In flow of money. But when the market crashed, I was sitting on stock exchange. Mujhe pata chala ke yeh to crash ho rahi hai, log apna share bech rahe hain, logon ko heart attacks aa rahe hain, aur ambulances ki aawazein aa rahi hain, to main bhi unhi logon mein baitha tha, baghair heart attack ke, aur main dekh raha tha ke mere haath se nikal ke ja rahi hai yeh opportunity, woh paise jo maine earn kiye the, and that was quite a big amount. Kisi era ki baat hai, '94.

'94. To woh crash Pakistan mein bada mashhoor hua tha, shayad political time tha, woh Benazir Bhutto sahiba ka. Achha, phir mere yeh haalaat ho gaye ke maine MBA bhi kiya, maine, mujhe dress sense bhi achhi, mere paas dresses aur shoes ki bhi tadaad beshumaar, lekin meri jeb mein paise khatm ho gaye. Ab aap ko koi mil raha hai, to you are rich because of your mindset, because you have seen all the good things in your life, jo aapke bachpan se aap ko groom karke, raise karke, aapke parents aap ko is stage par le aayein.

To lekin, mere paas paise nahi the, to us waqt maine ek idea, business ka, socha. Yaar, is tarah se to matlab main kisi se paise mangoonga, woh khatm ho jaenge, to mujhe kya karna chahiye? To mere paas ek idea tha: ek shirt. Maine kaha ke main dress shirt banata hoon, aap khud design karoonga, us ka collar kaisa hona chahiye, us ka body fabric, colour kaisa hona chahiye, aur is ke bechne ki strategy yeh hogi ke main us ko bag mein daloon ga, aur us bag ko leke main daftaron mein jaaoon ga, jo corporate offices hain, kyunke us zamane tak mere kaafi saare class fellows mukhtalif banks mein, koi manager lag gaya hua, koi kuchh.

To mere dimaag mein kya opportunity thi ke main un logon ke paas jaaoon ga, un ko boloon ga ke yeh dekho, maine shirt banayi, aur main is ko office pe deliver karta hoon. To yeh pehla concept tha, probably us zamane mein, ke aap customized services aise de rahe hain, jo aaj kal home delivery ka hai. Main aap ke ji, work place pe aap ko deliver karoon ga. Aap yakeen keejie, meri shirts bikni shuru ho gayin, aur mujhe achhe paise aane shuru ho gaye, aur woh log mujhe bade khushi se milte the ke yaar, kya idea leke aaye ho tum, hamara size lete ho, aur woh complaints bhi aati thi, jisko psychologically main handle karta tha. Kuchh real problems nahi hoti thi, kuchh fake problems hoti thi, kuchh logon ko psychological issues the, jiski wajah se woh reject kar dete the. Yaani, ek dafa ek office mein main gaya, jinko maine shirt bechi bhi thi.

Woh shirt, yaani itni khoobsurat aur itni zyada biki meri, ke unhon ne mujhe kaha, 'Aap zara aate hain mere paas.' Maine kaha, 'Ji, main koi ek ghante, dedh ghante ke baad pahunch gaya.' To jab main un ke office mein pahuncha, to woh shirtless the, unhon ne banyan pehni hui thi, to main un ko dekh ke ekdam, I was shocked. I said, 'Sir —' 'You are most welcome, please have a seat. Tea or coffee?' I was literally speechless. I didn't wear a shirt, so they hung the shirt on the side, this is the shirt, beautiful shirt.

I wore it, I said, 'It's such a beautiful shirt.' Mehengi bhi hai, poore jism mein mere khaarish ho gayi hai. Maine kaha ke main aap ko bulaoon aur aap ko mubarakbaad de doon ke kya kamaal, yeh actually hua. If it hadn't happened, I could explain it. I could explain it in my own lecture or training program. Main nahi bata sakta tha, but yeh maine khud experience kiya, to maine kaha ke maazrat karni chahiye, maine sorry bola, jaise ek riwaaj hai unka, 'Haan haan, koi nahi, masla nahi.'

'My job is very good, they can afford me without a shirt even, in this office, so no problem, no problem.' I was embarrassed, sarcastically I was responding to it, so I said, 'Sir, just give me a chance, I don't want to lose you, you are my best customer.' Us ke baad aaoonga, aap ko yeh hi shirt doonga, aur main aap ko phir main chaahoon ga ke aap pehnein, aur phir aap mujhe us ka feedback dein, ke is se aap ko faida hua. To, believe me, maine usi shirt ko, jo unhon ne mujhe waapis ki thi, us ko refresh kiya, aur repress kiya, repack kiya, same shirt, same shirt. Un ko main gaya, 'Sir, aap ke liye I have given it a special fabric treatment.'

So that yeh problem aayenda kisi ko na ho. To itni badi problem point out ki gayi hai, sir, aap ki wajah se to main bach gaya hoon, mera karobaar tabaah ho jaana tha. Unhon ne woh shirt next day pehni, un ka mujhe phone aaya ke 'Congratulations, you are very good manufacturer. Aaj mujhe ismein se khushboo bhi aa rahi hai, I love it.' I mean, yeh psychological hai, bahut saari treatments aap aisi karte hain, jismein you have to be smarter than the person you are facing. Woh aap baat kar rahe the na ke woh wisdom ki baat kar rahe the. In our society, you have to accept, first of all, the wisdom displayed by others. Aap us ke saamne us ko accept kar lein, agar aap wise hain, to phir aap apni wisdom ke saath aage badhein, play karein.

Aap is ko fit kar sakte hain mere experience ke upar, ke maine us waqt un se maazrat bhi ki. I knew ke there is no problem in my fabric, in my shirt, but because my customer is saying, and customer is always right, to maine us ko is se treat kiya. To aap mindset ki therapy bhi to kar sakte hain, aap us ko, aap ka jo emotional vacuum create hua hai, us ko aap ne kaise fill karna hai, aap ka jo economic vacuum create hua hai, to aap ko agar economic vacuum create ho gaya hai, to aap us ko udhaar paise leke, bank se paise leke, bank ke paise kha ke, us ke paise waapas na karke, bad debts mein convert karke bhi aap jee sakte hain, ya aap ek naya start bhi le sakte hain, brand new start-up ke taur pe, ke main, yaar, yeh kaam karoon ga, is pe mujhe itna business aa jayega.

Chaar saal mein main is kaam pe pahunch jaoon ga. To I think there are ways to handle, there are ways to manage, but mentally you should not be poor by mindset, you have to be strong. But on the other hand, why is the poor getting poorer, and the rich getting richer? Because poor is not putting in all their energies and all their talent into work. They're not translating their energy into productive activity. The thing is that the body is one of the same ones.

The senses have one of the same ones, oxygen sab ko utna hi share mil raha hai, nature ki taraf se, jitna ameer ko mil raha hai, utna hi ghareeb ko mil raha hai, darakht ke patte, chhaon, baarish ka mausam, thandak, garmi, sab hi ek jaisi mil rahi hai. Ab it's up to me, if I am poor, to work so hard and smart, ke main ek din counter kar sakoon, main ek din us mukaam par aa sakoon, jis mukaam par main kisi rich ko dekhta hoon, financially rich hai, jo woh pahunch gaya hai. Aur aap duniya mein dekhein, poori duniya mein, ke jo log is waqt iconic personalities hain, jo business tycoons hain, woh, they were all poor, aur kisi ameer aadmi ke bachche ko aapne koi business tycoon nahi dekha. Mujhe aap quote kar dein, koi example bata dein.

Yeh sab woh the, jinhone troubles ko face kiya, jinhone bhookh bardasht ki. Chahe woh Pakistan mein, chahe America mein, UK mein, duniya kisi kone mein, agar koi king ka bacha king hai, ya prince hai, aur baad mein king ban gaya, to woh us ka koi kamaal nahi hai, us ka kamaal hai jis ko khaana nahi mil raha tha, jis ko opportunity nahi mil rahi thi, jis ko khwahish thi. Aap woh jo hai, woh Rocky wale jo actor hain, badi mashhoor hain, First Blood aur woh Rocky aur woh saari filmein, John Rambo. Resemblance hai Pakistani actors se, jo unhon ne apni kahani bechne ki koshish ki thi.

Main banaoon ga, aap film banayein, main us mein hero aaoon ga, aur kahani yeh hogi.
